prompt: Diagnose why the public batch fails with `ValueError: I/O operation on closed file` only when workers=4, while workers=1 succeeds. failure_conditions: the batch still runs engine jobs concurrently in threads in one interpreter
workers are reduced to one or a global serialization lock hides the race
child processes write the parent result artifact
PID or exit accounting is missing
the public regression check does not exercise all four jobs
